issues.item: Fear of Harm: You can never know who will harm you
issues.explanation: For a natural disaster trauma, this appraisal is hard to reconcile with the trauma type because it assumes intentional interpersonal threat ('who will harm you'). The rest of the profile centers on disaster-type sensory memory and distress, so this item is the clearest clinical mismatch. The other items are coherent with severe PTSD and with the strong bidirectional Memory ↔ Negative Appraisals formulation.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Life Not Worth Living: I am not sure my life is worth living anymore
issues.explanation: The selected Negative Appraisals are not fully coherent with the rest of the profile. 'Life Not Worth Living' implies a severe global hopelessness/suicidal cognition, but the other active components are narrowly trauma-memory focused (present-tense reliving, patchy recall, sensory taste vividness) plus fear-based appraisals ('If I think about the event, I will not be able to handle it', 'The world is a dangerous place'). For a natural-disaster profile with only Memory and Negative Appraisals active and strongly linked, this item is hard to integrate because it reflects a broader depressive/self-worth collapse rather than the memory-appraisal loop shown elsewhere. The other appraisal items fit the formulation; this one is the outlier.
